decisions: For these P/C cards model_jp is not an affiliation: it is line 1 of the description, cut mid-word into desc_jp. So each card's English is written as one paragraph and split: model_en = first wrapped line (<=43 bytes, <=380 px), desc_en = the rest (2 lines). Total budget about 120-128 chars. All 106 checked with tools/textenc.wrap(380, 43).
Duplicate cards (P-xx and their C-xx copies, LB/NZ and Federation/CV variants) use identical text.
Labels = card number without hyphen + name_en (e.g. 'P35 Amuro Ray (CCA)'). Variant suffixes (CCA), (Z), (ZZ), (XB), (LB), (NZ), (CV) kept; Federation suffix -> (Federation).
Abbreviations used to fit: Fed., Cmdr., Lt., MS, 1st-gen/2nd-gen, '& co.'/'and co.'. Cyber Newtype and Supreme Cmdr. per glossary.
Names not in the excerpt written in the standard form: Guntank, Zaku, Rick Dias, Anaheim, Al, Kennedy, Rasara, Kojima Battalion.
uncertain: P-57..P-64: 'Progress Male/Female A/B' is my own rendering of the Progress male/female A/B names; no glossary entry.
P-49..P-54: (LB)/(NZ) kept as written; meaning (likely Londo Bell / Neo Zeon) not confirmed.
P-55/P-56: Aegis's gender is unverified; I avoided pronouns, but 'womanizer' and 'good guy' come from the source.
C-05: I read 'grew into a full-fledged one' as Bright growing ('came into his own'), not the crew.
C-21: The accident is written as 'MS accident'. I could not confirm how Burning actually dies.
C-23: the card says sergeant, the glossary role says Warrant Officer. I followed the card.
C-48: Rasara is not in the glossary. I used the common form 'Rasara'.
C-14/C-15/C-10: the glossary en is 'Aina Sakhalin', though its note mentions 'Sahalin'. I used en as binding, which also gives 'Sakhalin family'.
C-37: The Dakar support role is written as 'helped seize the Assembly' (the Dakar Federation Assembly).
